Undergraduate Texts in Mathematics are generally aimed at third- and fourth-year
undergraduate mathematics students at North American universities. These texts strive
to provide students and teachers with new perspectives and novel approaches. The
books include motivation that guides the reader to an appreciation of interrelations
among different aspects of the subject. They feature examples that illustrate key con-
cepts as well as exercises that strengthen understanding.
